item.title: Nonverbal 5-year-old who met Ms. Rachel over Zoom is released from ICE detention
item.description: His parents, asylum-seekers from Colombia, said their son’s physical and emotional health deteriorated during the weeks they were held at the Dilley Immigration Processing Center in South Texas.

item.title: Democrat flips Republican-held Florida state House district that includes Trump’s Mar-a-Lago
item.description: Democrat Emily Gregory narrowly won the special election for the district Tuesday night, The Associated Press projects. Trump carried the area in 2024.

item.title: Cockroaches, surveillance and 16-hour days: The life of a North Korean worker in Russia
item.description: The workers are among more than 100,000 North Koreans being exploited as part of a state-sponsored labor program operating in 40 countries, researchers say in a new report.

item.title: Taylor Frankie Paul under investigation in connection with allegation of third domestic violence incident
item.description: Police in Utah said they are investigating an allegation of domestic violence from a 2024 incident that Dakota Mortensen made against Paul last month.

item.title: 'Oh, golly': Britain's embattled Starmer navigates Trump's Iran war ire
item.description: The unpopular British prime minister has been pelted with insults by the American president. That may be no bad thing for his domestic popularity.

item.title: Netanyahu says Israel will widen invasion of southern Lebanon
item.description: The announcement intensifies fears that Israel will model its invasion of southern Lebanon on its scorched-earth campaign in Gaza.

item.title: NASA Artemis II crew speaks on upcoming lunar launch
item.description: NASA Artemis II crew speaks on upcoming lunar launch

item.title: The world economy is experiencing the most severe oil shock in decades. The worst could still be on the way.
item.description: Analysts say rising gas prices are just the start. The most serious consequences of the war with Iran could hit the global economy in the coming weeks and months.

item.title: Congress ‘really in a jam’ as lawmakers return home amid DHS shutdown
item.description: The longest partial government shutdown in U.S. history continues with no end in sight. NBC News Capitol Hill Correspondent Julie Tsirkin discusses the pressure facing Congress as some Americans cancel spring break plans and lawmakers are accused of “living their lives.”

item.title: 'Barbie Dream Fest' in Florida sparks backlash among disappointed fans
item.description: A fan event called "Barbie Dream Fest" promised a big, pink weekend in Florida, but the way it actually played out looked a little different. NBC News' Emilie Ikeda reports on the widespread disappointment expressed online.

item.title: ICE agents will be stationed outside Marine Corps graduation events in South Carolina
item.description: As the U.S. continues to fight the war in Iran, the Marine Corps has boosted protection measures on bases, requiring everyone to present REAL IDs, passports or birth certificates to access any sites.

item.title: NASA prepares for Artemis II launch
item.description: Four astronauts are preparing for their journey around the moon. The mission was delayed this winter due to technical challenges. Lift off is scheduled for this Wednesday. NBC News’ Tom Costello reports from the Kennedy Space Center.

item.title: Are there talks to end the Iran war? Depends on which side you ask
item.description: Trump says talks with Iran are happening. Iran says there is no negotiation. While progress may be playing out behind the scenes, there's little public indication that the war is coming to a diplomatic end.

item.title: Women's NCAA Tournament: UConn, UCLA, Texas and South Carolina make Final Four
item.description: The Huskies will play the Gamecocks and the Bruins will take on the Longhorns this Friday in Phoenix.

item.title: Video shows fire and explosions in Isfahan, Iran, as the conflict continues
item.description: Video geolocated by NBC News show intense overnight explosions sending a fireball into the sky above Iran's central city of Isfahan.
